teachBack.prompt_for_child: In two or three sentences, be the teacher: how does the natural environment affect a community’s products, and why can those products be sold farther away when transportation improves?
must_cover: The natural environment affects which products a community has
Products are connected to how people live and work
Transportation helps move products to distant markets
teachBack.example_good_answer: If a community is near mountains or the ocean, people can grow or catch different products. Those products shape the jobs people do. When roads or trains get better, the goods can be sent to cities farther away and sold there.
